AC AMENDMENT (plan-review F5 + gap-analysis F4):
- [ ] Test asserts read_ledger on missing path returns schema_version='1.2.0' (after T2 lands)
  Verify: grep -q '1.2.0' tests/scripts/test-cycle-ledger-migration.sh
- [ ] Test includes mixed-format fixture: a single PR comment thread containing BOTH a v1.1.0 marker (legacy, no pr_number) AND a v1.2.0 marker (explicit pr_number) for the SAME pr_number/sha pair. Assert reconstruct_from_pr_comments returns a deduplicated, correctly-ordered cycle list with the v1.2.0 entry winning per the documented sentinel rule.
  Verify: grep -q 'mixed.format\|both.markers' tests/scripts/test-cycle-ledger-migration.sh
